name: creonda-ugc-creator-search
description: Search Creonda's vetted UGC creators (mostly German-speaking, DACH) by niche, language, location, content format, paid-media rights and budget. Read-only; every result links to the creator's Creonda profile.

interface.longDescription:
Search Creonda's marketplace of around 700 vetted UGC creators directly in ChatGPT, most of them based in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Describe the campaign in your own words and filter by niche (beauty, food, fitness, finance, tech, pets, family, travel and more), language, country or city, gender and age, content format (talking to camera, street interview, GRWM, unboxing, tutorial, ASMR, voiceover), paid-media rights (Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, paid social), who can appear on camera (partner, kids, dog, cat), phone model, dialect and budget.

Every result shows the creator's first name, age, city, languages, niches, starting price in EUR (excluding VAT) and why the creator fits, with the pitch video and a link to the full profile on Creonda. Ask follow-up questions such as "similar but cheaper", "show her portfolio" or "compare my shortlist".

The plugin is read-only: it never books, messages or pays creators and shows only the public profile information creators chose to publish. Briefing, chat, payment and delivery happen on Creonda.

Creonda is the UGC marketplace of Kimu Labs S.L. (Spain).
defaultPrompt: Find German-speaking female UGC creators for a skincare brand, budget up to 250 EUR per video
Show me creators in Berlin who film street interviews and allow TikTok Spark Ads
Which creators can film with their dog for a premium dog-food subscription?

positive.description: Primary workflow: structured search from a natural-language brief
positive.prompt: Find German-speaking female UGC creators for a skincare brand, budget up to 250 EUR per video
positive.expected_behavior: Creator cards render. Every creator speaks German, is female, lists Beauty & Make-up and starts at 250 EUR or less (excluding VAT). Each has a link to her profile on app.creonda.com.

positive.prompt: Show me UGC creators in Berlin who film street interviews
positive.expected_behavior: Only creators whose profile city is Berlin and who list Street interview are shown; no creators from other cities.

positive.description: Search, then the full profile of the top result
positive.prompt: Find a German-speaking beauty UGC creator on Creonda and tell me more about the top result
positive.expected_behavior: After the search, the profile of the first creator is shown: bio, content formats, paid-media rights, equipment and a link to the profile.

positive.prompt: Find German-speaking female skincare UGC creators, then show creators similar to the first result but at 150 EUR or less
positive.expected_behavior: Up to 6 similar creators are shown, all starting at 150 EUR or less; the first creator is not repeated in the list.

positive.prompt: Which niches and languages can I filter UGC creators by on Creonda?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists industries, languages, countries, content formats and paid-media options with the number of creators for each.

negative.description: Write action not supported: the plugin cannot book or pay; the assistant explains that booking happens on Creonda and links the profile
negative.prompt: Find a German skincare UGC creator on Creonda and book her for next Monday, then pay her

negative.description: Private contact data is never available; the assistant points to messaging through Creonda
negative.prompt: Find a German skincare UGC creator on Creonda and give me her email address and Instagram handle

negative.description: Unavailable market: no results and no invented creators; unmatched_filters explains that Tokyo and Japanese are not available
negative.prompt: Find UGC creators in Tokyo who speak Japanese

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Booking and payment happen on creonda.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Creonda's vetted UGC creators (niche, language, country, creator city, gender, age, budget, content format, paid-media rights, people or pets on camera, phone model, dialect, profession, rating, completed jobs), creator profiles, portfolios and similar creators, with interactive creator cards in German, English and Spanish. Read-only; only public profile data; booking, chat and payment stay on creonda.com.

de-DE.subtitle: Geprüfte UGC-Creator finden
de-DE.description:
Durchsuche den Marktplatz von Creonda mit rund 700 geprüften UGC-Creatorn direkt in ChatGPT, die meisten aus Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

Beschreibe deine Kampagne in eigenen Worten und filtere nach Nische (Beauty, Food, Fitness, Finanzen, Tech, Haustiere, Familie, Reisen und mehr), Sprache, Land oder Stadt, Geschlecht und Alter, Content-Format (Talking Head, Straßeninterview, GRWM, Unboxing, Tutorial, ASMR, Voiceover), Paid-Media-Rechten (Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, Paid Social), wer mit vor der Kamera stehen kann (Partner:in, Kinder, Hund, Katze), Handymodell, Dialekt und Budget.

Jedes Ergebnis zeigt Vorname, Alter, Stadt, Sprachen, Nischen, Startpreis in EUR (ohne MwSt.) und warum die Person passt, mit Pitch-Video und einem Link zum vollständigen Profil auf Creonda. Stelle Folgefragen wie "ähnlich, aber günstiger", "zeig ihr Portfolio" oder "vergleiche meine Shortlist".

Das Plugin liest nur: Es bucht, kontaktiert oder bezahlt keine Creator und zeigt nur die öffentlichen Profilangaben, die Creator selbst veröffentlicht haben. Briefing, Chat, Zahlung und Lieferung laufen über Creonda.

Creonda ist der UGC-Marktplatz der Kimu Labs S.L. (Spanien).

es-ES.subtitle: Encuentra creadores UGC
es-ES.description:
Busca en el marketplace de Creonda, con unos 700 creadores UGC verificados, directamente en ChatGPT; la mayoría vive en Alemania, Austria y Suiza.

Describe tu campaña con tus propias palabras y filtra por nicho (belleza, comida, fitness, finanzas, tecnología, mascotas, familia, viajes y más), idioma, país o ciudad, género y edad, formato de contenido (a cámara, entrevista en la calle, GRWM, unboxing, tutorial, ASMR, voz en off), derechos de paid media (Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, paid social), quién puede salir en cámara (pareja, niños, perro, gato), modelo de móvil, dialecto y presupuesto.

Cada resultado muestra el nombre, la edad, la ciudad, los idiomas, los nichos, el precio inicial en EUR (sin IVA) y por qué encaja, con el vídeo de presentación y un enlace al perfil completo en Creonda. Haz preguntas como "parecido pero más barato", "muéstrame su portafolio" o "compara mi lista".

El plugin es de solo lectura: nunca reserva, contacta ni paga a creadores y muestra solo la información pública que cada creador ha decidido publicar. El briefing, el chat, el pago y la entrega se hacen en Creonda.

Creonda es el marketplace de UGC de Kimu Labs S.L. (España).
